infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NAV POD uses your location for scooter route navigation.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: NAV POD requires continuous location access to keep updating your handlebar display even when the screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: NAV POD requires Bluetooth to communicate turn instructions to your ESP32 handlebar display.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow NAV POD to access location continuously for live route updates.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow NAV POD to update your handlebar display even when the screen is locked.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Allow NAV POD to connect to your ESP32 handlebar display.
